clips.title: The story
paras: South Tide's Run follows Silverpine Forest's southwestern edge beside the cold Great Sea. These damp shores border the forested interior and form the southern counterpart to North Tide's Run.

Along Silverpine Forest's southwestern edge, the Great Sea meets a desolate shore. The eastern roads lead toward the Greymane Wall under the forest's protection, but this open coastline takes the western tides. The bleak stretch remains largely untouched by the settlements inland.
